speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Keep to your half of the mat, Master Shakespeare. The board is behind you, and the stone is damp.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have my half, Mistress. I will ask the board before I leave it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Look at the north aisle. Every house that went out of the City in July is back in its bench.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The aisle is full. That is the whole of what I am going to say about it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And our neighbour is in his fur, three pews ahead, as straight as a yard-wand. His sword-bearer is at the pew's end.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: From all sedition and privy conspiracy, from all false doctrine and heresy.

speaker: john_spencer
text: Good Lord, deliver us.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good Lord, deliver us.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: That it may please thee to bless and keep the Magistrates.

speaker: john_spencer
text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: We beseech thee to hear us, good Lord.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: He gives the book its answer and he does not look aside. You have your thumb at your cheek.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The jaw has a pulse in it. The litany need not take notice.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: In all time of our wealth, in all time of our tribulation, in the hour of death, and in the day of judgement.

speaker: john_spencer
text: Good Lord, deliver us.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good Lord, deliver us.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Rise when the book tells you, and do not make a story of the rising.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The back is the back I brought in. I am not mending it by standing.

speaker: josias_thwaite
text: The sermon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have lost the head he is on. I am not going back for it.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then you have learned nothing, and you may say so at dinner without dressing it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nothing. The jaw is the part of the hour I can repeat.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Home, then. I am carrying the cushion, and I am not stopping in the lane to be told a story.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Home. There is nothing from this aisle that dinner needs.
